name: Kinetic Slides to Prompt
move: kinetic STOP MAKING SLIDES typography pixel-dissolves into a dark prompt, then a camera push reveals an orange product workspace
how: Three oversized words occupy sequential white/red title cards while seeded square particles gather at their edges. The type uses anticipation, a fast expo landing and a very small settle. The composition cuts to charcoal, where JUST BRING THE IDEA types in and IDEA receives an orange focus pill. An orange scanline landscape then rises behind a glass prompt bar; the camera pushes 1.0→1.22 while cursor and attachment chips land in visual-hierarchy order.
adapt: Replace the three opening words and prompt copy; recolour the accent to the product brand. Keep the hierarchy: one word per cut, one highlighted idea, then one primary field.
port: Build the pixel field once with seeded positions. The seek function derives visibility and transforms from time. In a shots.js port, scope each scene and drive the same time proxy.
caveats: Procedural orange landscape substitutes for the photographed/scanline source
Opening is an authored motion study of the first product-film act
